description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain activation resiliency, specifically testing recovery from stale or poison grain directory entries in scenarios involving local and remote silo activation attempts.

classes.name: GrainLocatorActivationResiliencyTests
classes.description: Contains tests verifying Orleans' ability to recover from poison directory entries during grain activation, including both local and remote silo scenarios.

methods.name: ReactivateGrainWithPoisonGrainDirectoryEntry_LocalSilo
methods.description: Tests that a grain can recover from an invalid directory entry pointing to the same silo by detecting and updating the poison entry during activation.

methods.name: ReactivateGrainWithPoisonGrainDirectoryEntry_RemoteSilo
methods.description: Tests that activation requests forwarded from a secondary silo to a primary silo correctly handle poison directory entries, ensuring proper recovery and activation.
